time_convention: logged index i is t = (i+1)*LOG_DT; rollout step k is branch_time + (k+1)*LOG_DT; model step k is t[t0] + (k+1)*LOG_DT
reference_note: state-conditioned diagnostic: every branch shares the full simulator state at the fork (hidden manoeuvre mode, intent and reaction state frozen) and re-seeds only future decision/sensor/wind streams; the predictor conditions on observations only

hpd_mc.component_draws: torch.Generator seeded 12 (released: unseeded torch default generator)
hpd_mc.threshold: torch.quantile of MC log-densities at 1 - nominal

group.unit: rollout group (episode, origin step, target slot)

episode_cluster.unit: episode (all groups of an episode share the same branch realisations, so they are not independent)

gate.note: released MC fields came from an unseeded (clock-seeded) torch default generator: exact equality is not attainable, consistency is tested against replicate component streams

mc_consistency.sd_floor_rule: half the rounding unit; quantile fields (median/q25/q75) at the 1/B lattice step, B = 60 branches
